draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.50, the 6th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 1st of 29 at CB. He lasted until pick 47, well after his grade rank (6th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Jaycee Horn. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 3 passes defended in 2024, 21st of 29 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Arizona Cardinals (reserve). 12 career games and 10 starts over 1 completed season, plus 2 so far in 2026. Still developing: 3 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: passes defended 10 (80th percentile). Weak spots: missed tackle rate 15.9% (14th percentile), passer rating allowed 109.6 (18th percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 cornerback who played: 63.0% season snap share against a median of 27.6%, above the norm.
